findings.title: The rejection test proves timestamp equality, not that the clock is read exactly once
findings.retires: The unverified portion of the approved requirement that a plan claims write retires the second clock read
findings.severity: Blocking when a successful claims write invokes either plan.now_iso or store.now_iso more than once; currently the implementation invokes it once, so this is a coverage finding.

findings.title: The promised unchanged default behavior of store.put has no regression test
findings.specimen: attavo/store.py::put at commit 54382f749237c4d6663b59eb8b2de57c6850df10; tests/test_store.py is unchanged despite being claimed
findings.retires: The unverified compatibility promise that callers omitting at retain the existing clock-derived envelope timestamp
findings.severity: Blocking when a store.put caller that omits at receives any timestamp other than its single now_iso result; currently the fallback implementation preserves that behavior, so this is a coverage finding.
